posts.author: Litningman06
posts.body:
If you’re using 2k3, making the battle charsets completely transparent should solve your problem. Otherwise, using a back view of your characters in the foreground could also have a cool effect. Think phantasy star
This image demonstrates option B. Note how the character has her back to the camera. Again, if you don’t like that idea, then completely transparent player characters is an option too.

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body: By the way, RPG Maker 2000 does it this way by default (but has other differences too, such as using a turn-based battle system).
